description: The plot illustrates how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” changes with different prompt lengths for two vision-language models evaluated on two benchmarks, shown as four colored line series with markers and a legend. The x-axis is labeled “Prompt Length,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from 0 to 1024 with labeled ticks at 0, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.1 to 0.6 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.1 intervals. The blue solid line with circle markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep) increases across the x-axis, starting near 0.22 at prompt length 0, rising to about 0.46 at 512, and reaching about 0.56 at 1024. The orange solid line with square markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep) also increases, beginning around 0.16 at 0, moving to about 0.53 at 512, and ending near 0.60 at 1024. The green solid line with triangle markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) rises from about 0.08 at 0 to roughly 0.48 at 512 and to about 0.57 at 1024. The red solid line with diamond markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) increases from approximately 0.25 at 0 to about 0.54 at 512 and continues upward to around 0.66 at 1024.
